made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/comida-sheet-make.js, from comida-set.html (window.COMIDA.E) and the design of La comida (the orchestrator's p8-spec, general rules and section comida). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 60. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), z up; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 60 + 13 v - 22.5 z. The picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62. The rail is at v 0.15; the long table is at u 0.1, v 4.9 (half-width 1.9, half-depth 0.6); the four chairs along its far side are E.SEATS: (-1.325, 4.04), (-0.375, 4.04), (0.575, 4.04), (1.525, 4.04) (seat top z 0.44; the table's top z 0.74)
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the floor; z 0.44: a chair's seat top; z 0.74: the long table's, the station's low or the serving table's top; z 1.6: the station's shelf) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): its bottom middle is on the spot. scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty), 41 for a child; abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30 (her middle), her feet on the bottom edge; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela sitting mkAbuelaS (52 x 50): column 17 (her middle) and row 36 (her lap) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat; a grown-up sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 11 a grown-up: 41, t 7 a child: 33) on (sx, sy); the dog mkPerro('sit') (30 x 22): column 15 and its bottom edge; a small thing: see spot. Nobody is drawn turned (the makers draw them from the front)
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.seat: whoever sits at the long table sits along its far side, facing us, hung by the lap on the seat's top (z 0.44); the table's top (z 0.74) is nearer the camera than the seat and hides whoever sits from about the waist down (the set's depth hides them: check on-seat, heads-clear)

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the long table and its chairs, the station, the serving table and the pot hide whoever is behind them. Nothing in this set sways.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The same rule as El cruce's sheet: the upright plane through the feet
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the ground (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28, the dog .3) (open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits on a chair or stands on a table (z above 0) casts none: neither is ground (a shadow cast at the floor under them would show in front of them)
